description:
Our signature drop-bar bike packing frameset built with big miles and big plans in mind. It's a true go-anywhere, do-anything machine. If you can conceive it you can achieve it aboard the Dream Engine.

Every Dream Engine frame is handmade in the USA and was designed with our thoughts on back country exploration, Tour Divide racing, fire road epics and endless singletrack ribbons. Of course it can also crush gravel and tour on all surfaces as well.

It fits a very large tire, has boatloads of mud clearance, and was built with all-day and multi-day comfort in mind.

You’ll find a full suite of features that include:

Three pack mounts on top and bottom of the down tube, bottle mount on the seat tube, top tube bag mounts, and rack and fender capability.

The frame is built around the Curve Seek 430 fork which has three-pack mounts on each leg and internal dynamo and brake routing. We like this fork because it's short axle to crown allows for a larger main triangle, which allows for a bigger frame bag and more carrying capacity. Each three pack mount can hold 8kg according to the manufacturer.

For cable management, we us our modular system which allows the cleanest possible appearance and can be customized for AXS or 1X mountain setups. We use full-round cable guides on the stays as we find plastic zip ties on high-end bikes to be an inelegant compromise.

Clearance for 29x2.6" tires in rear and 29x3.0" in front.

GEOMETRY

Drop bar off-road geometry designed to be nimble in the tight stuff and carry a load with stability and confidence. The generous stack and longer wheelbase provide comfort and stability when riding all day or descending on loose terrain.

FRAME SPEC

Hand built in the USA

Curve Seek 430 Fork

Includes handcrafted Jen Green headbadge

Clearance for 29 x 2.6" tires

Three pack mounts on top and bottom of down tube

Water bottle mount on seat tube

Top tube feedbag mounts

Fender mounts

Rack Mounts

Stealth dropper routing

Tapered head tube with external cup: EC34/44

73mm bottom bracket shell

Flat mount brake

Boost Spacing

Rear Thru Axle M12 X 1.5

TIMELINE & SIZING

All Dream Engines are built to order with your choice of options and paint. Expect 4-5 months of build time. Please see sizing chart located in the photos above. Custom sizing is available at no additional charge.

Contact us to go custom.

COMPLETE BIKE BUILD

We work with all major component suppliers in the industry and would love to build you a complete bike. Contact us to get started.

SAFETY

Please read the bicycle owners manual before riding. This is important for safe operation of your new bike.
Bicycle Owners Manual
